bullets.text: I learned that **Boldyn Networks** has launched the UK’s first open-RAN neutral-host 5G system at Sunderland’s Stadium of Light, partnering with **Virgin Media O2** to enhance connectivity for fans and improve digital services.

I found out that the **Online Safety Act** is driving users towards risky free VPN services, raising concerns about data privacy and security as many inadvertently expose their data to servers in jurisdictions with poor privacy standards.
I discovered that the UK’s full-fibre broadband rollout is nearing 80%, with **Openreach** leading the charge by adding nearly a million new full-fibre premises in the first half of 2025.

I noted that despite a stagnant overall broadband market, full-fibre adoption in the UK surged, with **Openreach** extending its network to over 19 million premises and adding 566,000 new full-fibre customers in a single quarter.

I learned that **EE** has been named the best overall mobile network in the UK for the twelfth consecutive year, achieving a median download speed of 110.8 Mbps, which is more than double that of its closest competitor, **Vodafone**.

I found that **BT Group** has signed a new five-year cloud partnership with **AWS** to enhance its customer solutions and modernize its technology infrastructure, aiming for improved agility and customer experience.

I noted that **Boldyn Networks** and **VMO2** are enhancing 5G connectivity at Sunderland’s Stadium of Light, showcasing a pioneering Open RAN technology that significantly improves the fan experience during events.
I learned that **Equinix** is exploring nuclear power to support its data centers, aiming to address future energy demands and enhance sustainability in its operations.

I discovered that the telecoms industry is grappling with the challenge of transitioning to disaggregated networks, with many operators acknowledging the need for change but struggling to implement it effectively.

I found that **Huawei** has broken its silence on chip technology, revealing its new Kirin 9020 processor amidst ongoing US sanctions, indicating a shift towards greater transparency in its operations.
